ValidationRule.description: Prevent Using the Duplicate Contact/Broker while creating the Interaction Attendee Records.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( INCLUDES( Contact.Sync_Status__c,'Duplicate - Email'), INCLUDES( Contact.Sync_Status__c ,'Duplicate - OCV Id') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Selected contact is a duplicate, please select another contact.
